title: Circular Predictive Coding Unlocks Effective Depth
abstract: arXiv:2611.27610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive coding networks perform credit assignment through an energy minimization process. Despite their ability to train models with arbitrary network topologies, they have mostly been used to train feedforward architectures to match the performance of backpropagation. However, they fail to do so when the models become too deep, because error signals become unstable or vanish as they travel through many layers. We address this limitation with circular networks, which get their depth directly from the energy minimization, rather than from stacking layers. Formally, we prove that convergence to an equilibrium of the energy functional of a circular predictive coding network approximates the fixed-point iteration process of a deep equilibrium model, showing that circularity alone suffices to unlock effective depth. translated_title: 循环预测编码解锁有效深度
translated_abstract: 预测编码网络通过能量最小化过程执行信用分配。尽管它们能够训练具有任意网络拓扑结构的模型，但它们大多被用于训练前馈架构以匹配反向传播的性能。然而，当模型变得太深时，它们无法做到这一点，因为误差信号在穿过许多层时变得不稳定或消失。我们利用循环网络解决了这一局限性，循环网络的深度直接来自能量最小化，而不是通过堆叠层获得。在形式上，我们证明了循环预测编码网络收敛到其能量泛函的平衡点近似于深度均衡模型的不动点迭代过程，这表明仅凭循环性本身就足以解锁有效深度。在实证方面，我们展示了循环模型（i）在图像分类任务上优于其他相同规模的预测编码模型……
tldr: 该论文提出循环预测编码网络，其有效深度直接源自能量最小化过程而非堆叠层，并证明其平衡点收敛近似于深度均衡模型的不动点迭代，从而在不加深网络的情况下解锁了有效深度，在图像分类任务上优于同规模的其他预测编码模型。
en_tdlr: Circular predictive coding networks derive effective depth directly from energy minimization rather than stacked layers, with their equilibrium convergence provably approximating the fixed-point iteration of deep equilibrium models, thereby unlocking effective depth and outperforming same-sized predictive coding models on image classification.
